fields.why: 2021 age-adjusted rates and relative changes are ranked across 7 race/ethnicity groups ('highest among ... AI/AN'), an outcome measured per SPD group.
Only race/ethnicity groups are ranked against each other; age-group results are 2018-vs-2021 changes within each age level, with no claim comparing age groups.

The z-tests and gamma CI-overlap rule test 2018 vs 2021 within each race level (a non-SPD contrast within SPD levels, rule F6), so the cross-race ranking has no inferential assessment; the mechanical flag is a false alarm.
